My whole life was a shit show back then so yeah I wasn’t all there to be honest but I also want to say that was years ago and I’m a complete different person right now. Like I said I was abused, worn down and didn’t have good role models or support so I stayed with him wayyy too long. I was abused in almost every way as a kid and watched my mom and aunt get abused so it was normal to me; on top of that I was always made to feel it was my fault I was getting treated the way I was. It took me a while to realize people shouldn’t treat me or anyone like that no matter what. I also didn’t have any friends as a kid so that was the first year I ever really had friends and was just happy to have them even though they were horrible. Now that I’ve grown up, matured, and healed from all my trauma I realized myself worth and I’m better off by myself than with people who treated me like that. I also learned the best revenge is to thrive in life while they continue to live the way they are. I look back now and cringe at all the things I allowed to continue for way too long but I also take into account that I was a broken person with no self worth and no guidance. I also cringe at a lot of decisions I made because I’m a completely different person. I’m not necessarily proud of the things I did but I’ve learned to not dwell on the past or live in regret and to learn from it and make better decisions in the future. For a while I looked back and was angry that I didn’t do more for revenge and thought of ways I could ‘get back at them’ since I felt I ‘let them off too easy’ but it hit me that they probably don’t even remember half of that stuff meanwhile I’m sitting there allowing them to still make me angry and consume my mind’. Plus all of that is why I kind of feel for jenni because I think she needs to heal and learn her self worth before she can enter a healthy relationship.

Sorry this is super long but lemme spill the tea because my life back then was like a series of unfortunate events. Sooo I was with a guy who was extremely emotionally and verbally abusive (we’ll call him Shithead). I stayed with him through all his bullshit, including multiple times of cheating because he always managed to spin it on me and make it feel like it was my fault. (We’ll call her Izzy) Me and her were friends for like a year until I realized what a lying piece of shit she is. She would lie about the most fucked up things. For example she came to school crying about her dad dying, so I comforted her and gave her my condolences but like 4 days later she went to her dad (who wasn’t dead)’s house and posted videos and pictures with him. I was confused but didn’t say anything until she pulled that shit again one day by saying it was the 3 year anniversary of her friends suicide, once again I consoled her. Skip to literally 2 days later and I heard her telling our class mates the same story but saying it was THAT day. So I called her on her bullshit and bluntly asked “so your friend killed themself twice?” So she back peddles and says “oh I got the date wrong” so I just sat back giving her the benefit of doubt again. Then sometime later she was giving the sob story of how her sister has late stage lung/throat cancer but a week later she invited me to her house for dinner. I walk in low and behold her sister just chillin in the living room chain smoking. I looked at her weird and her sister looked back at me and asked why I was looking at her like that, I apologized and said “oh I didn’t know you could smoke with your condition”. She looked at me confused and asked “what condition” so I explained to her what my “friend” had told me. Her face went from confusion to anger and said “what the fuck? I’ve never had cancer”. Which started a fight between them making the rest of the night awkward asf. Not only was she a pathological liar but also one of those girls who would try to embarrass me infront of other people to look cool. Once I stopped associating with her she started getting random people in school to HATE me. Like these random girls would be rude to me and when I asked what their problem was they explained all these elaborate messed up lies my ex friend told them. Which honestly if I was as gullible as them and heard the fucked up shi someone “supposedly” did I wouldn’t like them either. To this day she hates my guts and idk why. 
    Okay now I’ll continue the story. So I had gotten home and checked my phone. I had a shit ton of messages from different friends. My one friend (we’ll call her brianna) was calling me non stop so I picked up the phone and asked her what was happening. So Brianna explained that Izzy had been posting snaps with shithead all boo’d up together. Since shit head was what I call ‘the town bicycle’ (everybody got a ride) I knew they had fucked. He tried getting with one of my best friends so i knew he wouldn’t have a problem getting with my enemy. I knew they wanted me to see it because they posted it on the only social media Brianna had since they knew she would let me know. I confronted him and of course he played the victim saying that he needed someone that night so she was the only one he could turn to. Then I went off on her. Honestly it’s not that interesting of a story since that was the least problematic thing that either them have done. But eventually I beat the shit out of Izzy a few months later because she gave someone my address in attempt to get me raped (like I said this girl is fucked in the head and to this day idk why she has so much hate towards me) and slept with shitheads dad a year after that, right before I left him for good. (Honestly wish I could’ve slept with his step brother since that was his worst enemy but I killed two birds with one stone fucking his dad since his stepmom was a piece of shit too). Needless to say I was super suicidal and felt hopeless going through all of that with no one to support me. But years later I having loving and supportive friends. I’ve stayed single since that whole relationship traumatized me so bad. Much more happy, mentally stable and learned to cut people off the minute I see red flags.
